The reviewed kernel integration patches and their merge preimages retain the
copyright and license terms of their upstream authors.

Official root managers:
  https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next
  https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU
  https://github.com/KOWX712/KernelSU
  https://github.com/LyraVoid/FinaSU

SUSFS integration:
  https://gitlab.com/simonpunk/susfs4ksu
  https://github.com/pershoot/KernelSU-Next

Generic GKI and additional manager build reference:
  https://github.com/WildKernels/GKI_KernelSU_SUSFS
  https://github.com/WildKernels/OnePlus_KernelSU_SUSFS

The OPlus build reference and its attribution remain in third_party/cctv-oplus.
Exact patch digests, original blob digests and upstream revisions are recorded
beside each reviewed patch under tools/patches/*-susfs23*-base/objects.json.
Local changes preserve the selected official APK's package, signature and native
version calculation. The two stable ports use the corresponding official SUSFS
2.3 native hook ABI, pinned in config/manager-susfs-pins.json.
